name: Timeless
note: The Timeless interface's palette (Settings > Client > Interface > Timeless): Timeless View, Pewter Hairline (2026-11-19; it replaces style D, Dusk Remastered: charcoal #14162c, surface #282042, bronze #4d4275, gold #f3dfb2, focus #a995d6, hp #e76f6f, mp #6fa8e7, tp #f0c46e, text #f6efe0, muted #c2b6cf). Same keys as assets/modern/theme.json; a key left out keeps the modern colour. Charcoal glass darkening toward the bottom, a pewter edge (bronze: every frame, tab and rule), pale silver titles (gold), steel-blue focus, the hourglass's gold sand (tp). job_war .. job_run: Timeless View's job plaques (the party list), one colour per job from its artifact and relic armour (owner, 2026-11-19); tune them here or in timeless-theme.json.
